newsitem.title: INDONESIA: JAKARTA STOCKS SEEN SOFT, RATES STILL A WORRY.
newsitem.headline: JAKARTA STOCKS SEEN SOFT, RATES STILL A WORRY.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen soft in slow trading on Monday as players are likely to stay on the sidelines on lingering worries over high interest rates, brokers
"Market tone is likely to stay weak due to worries over the high interest rates," one broker said.
Brokers, however, said the downside was likely to be limited because of a plunge last week.
On Friday, the Jakarta composite index closed down 2.50 points at 675.44 points. The index was down some 6.4 percent on the week from the 721.77 points closing on August 1.

Brokers said players were likely to watch for the outcome of Monday's meeting between Thailand, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and mostly Asian governments over a proposed aid package of up to $15 billion to help the Thai economy.
